A planted sole stays fixed on the floor while the other leg swings; show short double support, restrained heel-to-toe roll, low toe clearance and relaxed knees. Small opposite arm swing and support-linked shoulder/pelvis counterrotation; head stable, no exaggerated swaying. The coat has soft vertical draped folds, gently uneven trailing hem, and a subtle delayed response to each step rather than rigid cylindrical cloth or flapping. Ground shadows should make the planted foot readable. Restrained warm ivory-on-umber stippled sculptural look, not a fashion runway. This is a gait and cloth-timing study, not a scene composition reference. Silent.
